understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; when multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously to win the level.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shifted the currently selected piece by one grid cell, while adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed along when space allowed. Walls and boundaries could block movement, though their blocking behavior needed to be tested. Multiple pieces could be controlled by using CLICK with the piece's pixel/grid position, switching which selectable responded to movement.
